title: 用 n 个等圆盖住正方形
titleEn: Covering a square with n equal discs

knownBest.source: The construction by Tibor Tarnai and Zsolt Gáspár is reproduced in Nurmela and Östergård's HUT-TCS-A62 report (2000); optimality of the continuous problem was proved by Dénes Nagy (1974); the paper reports 0.32616058400398728086. The exact continuous construction is not literally writable on the nine-decimal coordinate grid, so this finished site row displays its verifiable grid representative 0.326160584140164.

The construction by J. B. M. Melissen and P. C. Schuur is reproduced in Nurmela and Östergård's HUT-TCS-A62 report (2000); the paper's best-known radius is 0.29872706223691915876, with optimality open. The nine-decimal certificate reconstructed from its vector figure and contact topology verifies at 0.298727062727013; it is a reference answer, not a new record.
